text:
- **Go pm is the only pm:** Python pm is gone from Yeeef/pm and yeeef-agents. pm now publishes each release with a note taken from its changelog.
- **Project tracking moves to Yeeef/pm:** pm-harness now tracks its work in Yeeef/pm, with its full history. The yeeef-agents copy is closed.
- **Site stays readable:** The site no longer shows "no such file" errors while git rewrites the records. Diagrams and images now read well on a phone.
- **Owner requests follow one rule:** A request with no sprint or task gets one opened first. The owner-request hook applies this same rule everywhere.
